Third-party AES and AES-CTR sources imported from `WaterJuice/WjCryptLib`.

Imported files:
- `WjCryptLib_Aes.h`
- `WjCryptLib_Aes.c`
- `WjCryptLib_AesCtr.h`
- `WjCryptLib_AesCtr.c`
- `UNLICENSE`

Source repository:
- `https://github.com/WaterJuice/WjCryptLib`

Reason for this subset:
- Upstream documents that AES-CTR depends only on the AES module, so these four source files are the minimal required set.
